en: Jupiter’s Great Red Spot is a massive storm wider than Earth that has been continuously raging for at least 300 years.
Pumice is the only rock that naturally floats on water because its rapid cooling traps millions of tiny gas bubbles inside.
Earth's gravity causes deep moonquakes by physically stretching and squeezing the Moon's solid rocky body as it orbits.
A single bolt of lightning heats the surrounding air to 30,000 degrees Celsius, making it five times hotter than the Sun's surface.
One handful of healthy forest soil contains more microscopic living organisms than the total number of humans currently alive on Earth.
If all Earth’s water filled a one-gallon jug, the freshwater available for human drinking would equal just one tablespoon.
A single teaspoon of a neutron star weighs six billion tons because extreme gravity crushes its atoms tightly together.
In the deep ocean, tsunami waves travel as fast as a jet airplane while remaining barely visible above the surface.
Venus rotates backward so slowly that one single day on its surface takes longer to complete than its entire year.
Diamonds and soft pencil lead are both made of pure carbon, just arranged in completely different crystal structures.
Without wind or water to erode them, astronaut footprints left in the Moon's dust will remain visible for millions of years.
An average fluffy cumulus cloud weighs over one million pounds because it contains billions of tiny suspended water droplets.
